purpose: Freeze one reproducible experiment suite covering AC groups, ACAll, public benchmarks, model comparisons, Expert ablations and sensitivity analyses.

common_protocol.outer_split: nested physical-device folds; identical folds within each dataset and experiment family
common_protocol.inner_validation: device-wise split from outer-development units, fixed before training
common_protocol.test_use: one final evaluation after validation selection; never used for tuning

industrial_grouping_rule.definition: For every eligible device u, L_u < 1000 cycles is ACSim and L_u >= 1000 cycles is ACCom. No manual exception or post hoc reassignment is permitted.

ACAll.definition: all eligible AC units pooled; ACSim/ACCom labels are retained only as metadata and are not used as a training/evaluation partition
ACAll.split_manifest: new ACAll device-wise folds generated and frozen before training

public.split_manifest: public device-wise folds generated and frozen before training

comparison_experiments.comparison_rule: same folds, seeds, target, prefix endpoints, tuning budget, stopping rule and metrics within each dataset
comparison_experiments.acall_rule: ACAll is an independent pooled 33-unit experiment; no ACSim/ACCom partition indicator is supplied to the model

variants.change: remove Wiener trend source; retain rolling-prefix STL source
remove rolling-prefix STL trend source; retain Wiener source
replace learned DWC fusion with deterministic trend combination
remove DWC gradual-trend branch while retaining residual processing
remove EDC residual branch and its AEP tokens
skip DWC/EDC separation and feed raw DI to the predictor
remove adaptive event partitioning; use the registered non-adaptive token control

ablation_experiments.controls: one-factor preprocessing change from full model; all other code, folds, seeds, target, budgets and stopping rules identical
ablation_experiments.test_use: test set is not used to choose an ablation variant

sensitivity_experiments.design: one-factor-at-a-time around the frozen reference; each registered value is evaluated without test-based selection
sensitivity_experiments.controls: all non-varied parameters remain equal to common_protocol; same predefined device folds and seeds; target definition, normalization, checkpoint rule, stopping rule and metrics unchanged
sensitivity_experiments.reporting: RMSE, MAE and P90AE in cycles; mean, outer-fold dispersion and seed dispersion for every registered value; no preferred value selected from test performance
sensitivity_experiments.launch_condition: all three preprocessing ablation run_status files verified_complete and ablation audit PASS

visualisation_and_archive.pdf: one multi-page PDF containing comparison tables, ACAll/ACSim/ACCom rankings, public benchmark rankings, ablation deltas, sensitivity curves, reliability, uncertainty and computational cost
visualisation_and_archive.source_rule: figures generated directly from verified prediction-level files; no hand-entered values
visualisation_and_archive.archive: code, configs, folds, manifests, predictions, metrics, figure scripts, environment and checksum manifest

approval_gate: Approved by the user on 2026-09-22; preprocessing ablation execution authorised.
